explanation: Bell, Whistle, Drum, and Chimes are all objects that inherently produce sound through their own physical mechanism (striking, blowing, or vibrating). A Microphone, conversely, captures or amplifies sound but does not generate it itself.

category: Signatories of the US Declaration of Independence
explanation: All tokens except George Washington are prominent figures who signed the US Declaration of Independence. George Washington was Commander-in-Chief of the Continental Army at the time and did not sign the document.

'Listen', 'Respond', 'Relate', and 'Refer' are all verbs typically followed by the preposition 'to' (e.g., listen to music, respond to a question, relate to someone, refer to a source). 'Believe' is most commonly followed by 'in' (e.g., believe in magic) or no preposition when followed by a clause.
